# RLAuditor
This repo contains demo code of running our RLAuditor on $SynTab$ dataset. 


## Requirements

To be able to run the demo code, please install the important packages listed in `requirements.txt`.

## Usage

The RL training algorithm is defined in `dqn_learn.py`.

The Q model is defined in `dqn_model.py`

The running script is given in `TrainingRL.ipynb`. More comments can be found in the files.
